statements.quote: In terms of investment priorities, AI will be our biggest investment area in 2024 -- both in engineering and compute resources.
statements.notes: 'Engineering' read as headcount/R&D opex; the sentence does not name expense categories.

statements.quote: In terms of investment priorities, AI will be our biggest investment area in 2024 -- both in engineering and compute resources.
statements.notes: 'Compute resources' read as capex (servers/data centers); it could also include opex such as cloud or depreciation.

statements.quote: But I want to avoid allocating a lot of new headcount, so we’re going to continue deprioritizing a number of non-AI projects across the company to shift people towards working on AI instead.
statements.notes: Headcount is reallocated toward AI. The sentence names no year, so code applies the default outlook year.

statements.quote: As part of our 2024 budget, we plan to selectively allocate incremental headcount toward four key company priorities: AI, infrastructure, Reality Labs, and monetization as well as toward our regulatory and compliance needs.
statements.notes: AI is one of several areas receiving incremental headcount.

statements.quote: Of those areas, we expect AI to be the largest area of increased investment as we further invest in Generative AI across our core products, internal tooling, and research efforts.
statements.notes: Context implies 2024, but the sentence names no year, so fiscal_year is null.

statements.quote: We anticipate our full-year 2024 capital expenditures will be in the range of $30-35 billion, with growth driven by investments in servers, including both non-AI and AI hardware, and in data centers as we ramp up construction on sites with the new data center architecture we announced late last year.
statements.notes: This is total capex. AI hardware is named as one driver of growth, so this is not an AI amount.
